##### Project general facts

Jules Verne Residences is a conceptual residential tower shaped around the spirit of travel and discovery. Sculpted curved balconies and warm evening lighting define the façade, while the arrival lobby sets the tone with a sculptural aquarium column and a library lounge. The collection ranges from studios and smart one-bedroom apartments to one- and two-bedroom residences, homes with a maid's room or a private terrace and penthouses, complemented by offices and retail units.

The rooftop is dedicated to wellness and leisure, with an infinity pool overlooking the skyline, a sky gym, a yoga studio, a sauna and a traditional hammam, and an observatory. Residents also enjoy a padel court, an outdoor gym, an outdoor cinema, a VR golf simulator, a mini golf course, a kids' pool and play area, BBQ and outdoor lounges, a library, a co-working area and The Travellers Club, a private residents' club hosting events, talks and experiences. Dedicated parking spaces come with EV charging stations.

Residences feature high-end finishing materials and a fitted kitchen with premium appliances. Sculpted curved balconies extend the living space outdoors.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Triangle is a residential community in the heart of new Dubai, set between Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. The community combines villas and townhouses with mid-rise apartment buildings, landscaped parks and quiet tree-lined streets, offering the privacy of a residential neighbourhood with the city within easy reach. It sits next to Jumeirah Village Circle, Al Barsha South, Jumeirah Park and Dubai Sports City.

Arcadia School is within walking distance, and further schools, nurseries, supermarkets, cafés and fitness studios are spread across the community and its neighbours. Circle Mall in Jumeirah Village Circle and Mall of the Emirates cover larger shopping needs, while Dubai Marina, JBR, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Internet City and Dubai Media City are within easy reach. Both main roads connect the community to Burj Al Arab, Kite Beach, DIFC, Downtown Dubai and Al Maktoum International Airport.

Jumeirah Village Triangle is a freehold area open to buyers of all nationalities. Its family-friendly character, central position between the coast and the inland business districts and steady demand from residents working in Dubai Marina, Media City and the surrounding hubs make it attractive for both end users and investors seeking well-connected homes with rental potential.
